definitions.explanation: A cabinet or boxlike piece of furniture for storing books.

examples.japanese: {本箱|ほんばこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧。
examples.english: I arrange books in the bookcase.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{本箱|ほんばこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{本|ほん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧いっぱいだ。
examples.english: The old bookcase is full of books.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき、{本箱|ほんばこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦{段|だん}ボール→段ボール：18885_danbooru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{詰|つ}め{直|なお}した。
examples.english: When I moved, I repacked all the books from the bookcase into cardboard boxes.

notes:
A cabinet or shelving unit for storing books. Slightly old-fashioned; ⟦{本棚|ほんだな}→本棚：04489_hondana⟧ is the more common word in everyday speech today.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {本箱|ほんばこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧しまう: to put away in the bookcase
- {本箱|ほんばこ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{取|と}り{出|だ}す→取り出す：04220_toridasu⟧: to take out of the bookcase
- {本箱|ほんばこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整理|せいり}する→整理する：21729_seirisuru⟧: to tidy the bookcase

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{本棚|ほんだな}→本棚：04489_hondana⟧: bookshelf — the most common modern word; typically open shelving
- ⟦{書棚|しょだな}→書棚：08529_shodana⟧: bookshelf — slightly more formal or literary than ⟦{本棚|ほんだな}→本棚：04489_hondana⟧
